title: Cataract And Correction
definition: A cataract is the medical condition characterized by the progressive clouding and opacity of the eye's natural crystalline lens, leading to decreased visual acuity; correction is primarily achieved via surgical replacement of the opaque lens with an artificial Intraocular Lens (IOL).
importanceInUpsc: Tested in UPSC CSE Prelims (Science & Tech: Human physiology, optical physics, public health schemes like NPBVI) and Mains GS Paper II (Health infrastructure, universal healthcare access, burden of avoidable blindness in India).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Cataract And Correction.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic human eye anatomy (cornea, pupil, crystalline lens, retina)
